Name: Instant Animals
Author: pinocchio1231
Description:
Inspired by InstantBuildings by BitWiseJon and BFAV by Paritee, you can now buy animals for your farm [i][b]on your farm[/b][/i].

Does NOT work with BFAV animals, base game animals only (sorry).

Hotkeys:
[list]
[*]J to open menu, J when menu is open to toggle between adult and baby livestock menu.
[*]Scroll wheel during adult/baby livestock menu to set friendship of animal toward farmer.
[/list]
Config:
Indicates if animals should cost their usual resources.
BuyUsesResources = false;

Indicates if animals are sold as adults or babies. (For when menu first opens)
BuyAdultLivestock = true;

Button to open and close the Instant Animals menu
ToggleInstantBuyMenuButton = SButton.J;

Source code [url=https://github.com/joisse1101/InstantAnimals]here[/url]
